retained_only.description: Paused local registry and candidate graph; not a portable proof package.
Later generated concrete certificates and full audit dependencies.
Three later 12-tile proof closures, 10-tile partial coverage and historical replay records.
Full 97,316,623,312-byte P/N table; reconstruct using the public C++ tools.
Compiled checker binary index inputs; only the selected bucket catalogue is published here.
Validated binary local summaries used by native workers.
Workstation orchestration and benchmarking harness; requires adaptation before another host can replay timings.
